SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Full Automation Mode
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summaryOn: ON — actions run automatically with NO confirmation. The agent can dismiss notifications, send replies, and press buttons unattended.
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summaryOff: OFF — every action asks you to confirm before it runs (recommended).

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Context follow-up
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summaryOn: ON — after triaging a message, call or appointment, the agent checks your calendar, recent activity and memories and suggests what to do. It only reads; every action still asks.
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summaryOff: OFF — triage decides from the notification text alone.

ListPreference.app:summary: Choose one calendar for reading and adding events, or All calendars for reading only. Additions require confirmation.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Print reasoning to system log
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summaryOn: ON — every decision, prompt and tool call is printed to logcat under MobileClaw-TRACE. Sensitive text is redacted.
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summaryOff: OFF — the agent still records its decisions; they are just not printed to the log.

Preference.app:title: What the agent remembers
Preference.app:summary: Everything the agent has learned about you, how it learned each thing, and a way to delete any of it.

Preference.app:title: Forget everything
Preference.app:summary: Permanently delete every stored memory. Separate from clearing agent history, and not included in it.

Preference.app:title: Action history
Preference.app:summary: Everything the agent has done — buttons pressed, replies sent, commands run, and confirmations that were rejected, dropped or expired.

Preference.app:title: Export data
Preference.app:summary: Save a copy of your chat history and the action audit trail to a file you choose. The database is excluded from cloud backup, so this is the only way to keep your own copy.

Preference.app:title: Clear agent history
Preference.app:summary: Permanently delete the record of what the agent has done and decided.
